research.title: LLM-based Remote Sensing Agent System
bullets: Developed a user-centric framework for remote sensing analysis, using LLMs as the reasoning core and natural-language interface for non-expert users.
Built ExpertsRS, a prototype multi-agent system based on AutoGen, with distinct agents coordinating remote sensing data, tools, and reasoning processes.
Demonstrated how natural-language interaction and interpretable result generation can lower technical barriers to remote sensing analysis.

research.title: Agent-oriented Research Assets for Urban Forest Remote Sensing
bullets: Developed a structured intermediate layer linking urban forest monitoring objectives with remote sensing variables, indicators, and data sources.
Organized domain knowledge into an agent-oriented representation to support retrieval and workflow assistance in urban forest biodiversity mapping.
Built an early-stage prototype connecting remote sensing variables, ecological indicators, and stage-wise analytical processes as reusable research assets.

research.title: GF-1 Data Loading and Service Development Based on Open Data Cube
bullets: Developed Python scripts for loading GF-1 satellite data into the Open Data Cube framework.
Implemented a web-based workflow for accessing and analysing loaded GF-1 imagery.
Built a prototype water-detection service using the ODC Web UI.

projects.title_zh: Scientific Research Harness：面向长周期科研任务的 Agent 执行基础设施
projects.context_zh: 博士研究与个人研究基础设施

bullets.zh: 围绕城市森林遥感博士课题，设计并实现 repo-based Scientific Research Harness，将问题定义、证据、决策、实验与写作状态组织为可审计、可交接的版本化研究资产。
建立阶段门禁、claim-level evidence、制品 QA 与 Agent handoff 机制，降低长流程 Agent 将候选结论误写为已验证事实、研究代码与论文叙事漂移等风险。
正在将博士研究进一步抽象为 TaskSpec、OperatorSpec、WorkflowGraph、Validate/Repair 与 WorkflowTrace 接口，探索科学约束和轨迹评测驱动的 Agent 可靠性。

projects.title_zh: Sheaf AI：面向 AI Agent 的本地知识与上下文基础设施

bullets.zh: 独立设计并开源 Agent-Native 知识系统，将网页、论文和个人笔记转化为可检索、可溯源、可复用的 Agent 上下文资产。
开发 Python CLI 与 MCP Server，支持混合检索、知识卡片和 Local-First 存储；v0.7.0 已发布至 PyPI，版本测试记录包含 1024 项通过、0 warning。
支持 Codex、Claude Code 等 Agent 环境的一键接入，并以精简工具面和结构化输出控制上下文开销与工具调用复杂度。

projects.title_zh: URSA / ExpertsRS：面向遥感分析的大语言模型多智能体系统

bullets.zh: 基于 AutoGen 构建遥感多智能体原型 ExpertsRS，以自然语言接收开放需求，协调数据、工具与分析角色完成遥感工作流并返回可解释结果。
从 2024 年起持续研究 Agent 工作流与领域工具调用；相关工作以第一作者发表于 Big Earth Data，并开放原型代码与标准化遥感工具。
当前围绕结构化任务、类型化工具、工作流验证、定向修复与轨迹化执行推进下一阶段研究。
